components.description: Any color on the interior ambient light. Your car's zones in a list (the ones your car has): give each the main color, its own or the car's, or pick All zones. Color bars for any shade, brightness (or follow the car's), the car's nine colors, and six presets that keep the whole look. Drive modes: a color for each drive mode (Sport, Comfort, Eco Pro, their Plus and Individual, Adaptive) that the light switches to with the mode, on or off. Works while the car's own ambient light is on. Needs the Comfort tool from the same source. Works with the touchscreen or the iDrive controller. iDrive 7 and
components.title: Ambient Light

components.description: Log the head unit in to your tailnet without a computer: shows Tailscale's state, the login link as a QR code to scan with your phone, the head unit's tailnet name and address, Rename (default mgu), Disconnect / Connect (switched off, still logged in) and Log out. Works with the iDrive controller too. Needs the Tailscale tool from the same source.
components.title: Tailscale

components.description: The front camera in the instrument cluster with a turn card and, near each turn, a blue turn sign (three chevrons pointing the way), from BMW Maps, Apple CarPlay or Android Auto; the camera shows with or without a route. Or on the head unit instead: the Camera button opens the camera's whole picture with the same card and sign, at any speed (Picture on: Head unit), for kerbs and tight gaps. iDrive 8: pick "Turn View AR" in the cluster's widget menu (from the car's next start after installing). iDrive 7: off at every start of the car; switch it on in this app and set Instrument cluster > Centra
